assertions.title: Guestbook list pages in cursor pages of at most 50
assertions.evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/g9-guest-api/VAL-GUEST-006-list-page1.json (GET /operator/reservations/guests -> 200, 50 guests, nextCursor present, total 148), VAL-GUEST-006-list-page2.json (GET ...?cursor=<90-char cursor> -> 200, 50 guests), VAL-GUEST-006-summary.txt, VAL-GUEST-006-network.txt (raw curl -w statuses: page1 200, page2 200, id overlap 0), VAL-GUEST-006-list-page1-trailing.json (404 body for the contract's trailing-slash URL)
assertions.notes: First page contains 50 guests and a nextCursor; following the cursor returns the next page of 50 with zero guest ids repeated from page one. Run twice (12:31 and 12:38 UTC) with identical results (second run total 161 as other validators create guests concurrently). No guest creation was needed (org already has >50 guests).
assertions.limitations: The contract writes the URL with a trailing slash (`GET /operator/reservations/guests/`); on the running server that exact path returns 404 {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"} (the Hono trailing-slash behaviour already recorded in the round guidance). The canonical path `/operator/reservations/guests` was used; the Pass criteria (<=50 + cursor, cursor page with no repeats) were verified on it.

assertions.title: Completing a booking updates profile stats
assertions.evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/g9-guest-api/VAL-GUEST-007-b1-create.json (POST .../book/reservations -> 201, rsv_8336d612-894b-46d5-aaa9-e3af24347280 #NB57WC, guest gst_facfe712-df9a-4849-ba64-778339c3ed0c), VAL-GUEST-007-b1-arrived.json / -seated.json / -finished.json (all 200), VAL-GUEST-007-profile-after-finish.json (GET /operator/reservations/guests/:id -> 200: visits 1, covers 2, lastVisitAt 2026-10-17T12:34:19Z, history row status finished), VAL-GUEST-007-sqlite.txt (rsv_guests visits=1 covers=2 last_visit_at=1792240459084 = 2026-10-17; rsv_reservations status=finished covers_actual=2), VAL-GUEST-007-summary.txt
assertions.notes: Guest created through a phone/host booking (channel=phone, partySize 2) and moved booked -> arrived -> seated -> finished with the prescribed operator route POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/:id/status. visits 0 -> 1 (+1), covers 0 -> 2 (+2), last visit date 2026-10-17 equals the booking's businessDate, and the visit history lists the booking with its final status finished.
assertions.limitations: No browser screenshot was taken: the Guestbook profile screen rendering is verified by groups b5/b6 (per the assignment). Counters and visit history were verified through GET /operator/reservations/guests/:id plus read-only sqlite. The booking was made on the current service day (2026-10-17), not the registry date 2026-10-28: the contract requires the last visit date to equal the booking's business date, and the implementation stamps lastVisitAt when the booking is finished, so only a booking finished on its own business date can satisfy it (the contract's own flow reads "from the Today list"). Transitions were driven through the operator status route, not the Today-list UI.

assertions.title: No-show and cancellation update profile stats
assertions.evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/g9-guest-api/VAL-GUEST-008-b2-create.json (201, rsv_0745f23f-9dfe-4431-a51a-40afc394c6f3 #V2P54R, 2026-10-28 20:00), VAL-GUEST-008-b2-noshow.json (POST status no_show -> 200), VAL-GUEST-008-b3-create.json (201, rsv_c0f2ee0e-6e8c-40a9-9a08-3548b84bd54c #SAZFEE, 2026-10-17 08:20 local), VAL-GUEST-008-b3-cancel.json (POST status cancelled -> 200, lateCancel true), VAL-GUEST-008-profile-after.json (GET -> 200: noShows 1, lateCancels 1, cancels 1, visits 1 unchanged; history shows one no_show and one cancelled), VAL-GUEST-008-sqlite.txt (late_cancel=1, cancelled_by=restaurant), VAL-GUEST-008-summary.txt
assertions.notes: Two further bookings for the same guest: B2 (2026-10-28) marked no_show; B3 (2026-10-17 08:20 local, start already inside the 120-minute cutoff) cancelled. no_shows 0 -> 1 and late_cancels 0 -> 1, visits stayed at 1, and the visit history shows one booking as no-show and one as cancelled (lateCancel true).
assertions.limitations: The contract's wording "cancel the other inside the free-cancellation window" conflicts with its own Pass criteria (late_cancels +1): a free, outside-cutoff cancellation would not be late. No browser screenshot (profile rendering covered by b5/b6).

assertions.title: System tag "frequent no-show" is derived and cannot be removed by hand
assertions.evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/g9-guest-api/VAL-GUEST-010-cycles.jsonl (10 separate bookings on 2026-10-28, each create 201 and no_show 200), VAL-GUEST-010-profile-after-cycles.json (noShows 11, derived tag tag_sys_frequent_no_show present, no first_visit), VAL-GUEST-010-delete-tag.json (DELETE /guests/:id/tags/tag_sys_frequent_no_show -> 400 {"error":"system_tag"}), VAL-GUEST-010-profile-after-delete-attempt.json (tag still present), VAL-GUEST-010-guestB-profile-1noshow.json (noShows 1, no frequent tag) vs VAL-GUEST-010-guestB-profile-2noshow.json (noShows 2, frequent_no_show present) threshold proof, VAL-GUEST-010-manual-assign-frequent-noshow.json (400), VAL-GUEST-010-sqlite.txt, VAL-GUEST-010-my-rows.txt
assertions.notes: 10 book+no-show cycles on the owned date 2026-10-28 (17:00-19:15 local, one booking per 15-minute slot); with the earlier no-show from VAL-GUEST-008 the guest sits at 11 no-shows and the profile shows the derived "Frequent no-show" tag. DELETE of tag_sys_frequent_no_show returns 400 system_tag and the tag remains on the next GET. The derivation threshold is proven at 2 no-shows with a second guest (1 no-show -> no tag; 2 -> tag), so the tag appears far inside the tenth cycle.
assertions.limitations: No browser check of the "no remove control" UI path (b5/b6 own the Guestbook UI); the API refusal and tag persistence were verified. The second guest used for the threshold proof is a pre-existing round-2 leftover guest in the same +155555509xx phone block (my bookings attached to it by phone match); the validator guest itself (gst_facfe712) was created fresh by the VAL-GUEST-007 booking.

assertions.title: Guest routes refuse tokens without guest grants
assertions.evidence: evidence/guest-channels-and-crm/g9-guest-api/VAL-GUEST-014-matrix.txt (PATCH /guests/:id, POST /guests/merge, POST /guests/:id/erase -> 403 for a book-scope token and for a read:reservation:any-only token, 401 with no Authorization header), VAL-GUEST-014-get-matrix.txt (GET /guests?q=x -> 403 / 403 / 401), per-case response bodies (VAL-GUEST-014-*.json), leak scan: no guest data in any VAL-GUEST-014 response body
assertions.notes: Both negative tokens (book scope with read+update:reservation only, and a token narrowed to read:reservation:any) get 403 {"error":"invalid_scope","expected":["guests"],"actual":"book"} on all four guest routes; the no-header control gets 401 {"error":"Missing bearer token"}. No response body contains guest data (grep for name/phone/email found nothing), and the refused PATCH/erase left the target guest unchanged (sqlite: name, version and erased_at intact).
assertions.limitations: The contract's GET URL carries a trailing slash (`/guests/?q=x`), which 404s on the running server (documented Hono behaviour); the canonical `/operator/reservations/guests?q=x` was used. The merge case used two synthetic ids so a hypothetical guard failure could not damage data.

frictions.description: The contract's guest URLs use a trailing slash (`GET /operator/reservations/guests/`, `GET .../guests/?q=x`); both return 404 {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"} on the running tenant-api. The canonical path without the slash returns 200/403/401.
frictions.resolution: Used the canonical route paths (the round guidance already records this Hono trailing-slash behaviour and says to use the exact route paths); the 404 body is kept as evidence.
